title: Algebraization of a formal pullback isomorphism with canonical quotient compatibility
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian and complete for $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], let $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, and let $J$ be the ideal sheaf associated to $I$. Let $p:Z\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $G$ be a coherent formal $J$-system and $F$ a coherent module on $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Given $\beta:p^*G\simeq F^\wedge$ [def-pc-module-pullback], there are a coherent $A_0$ on $S$, an isomorphism $e:G\simeq A_0^\wedge$, and $b:p^*A_0\simeq F$ such that for every positive level $n$, $p^*(\pi^{A_0}_n)p^*(e_n^{-1})\beta_n=b\pi^F_n$. The projections are the actual sheaf quotient maps.

proof.text: Take the finite completed module E(G) supplied by coherentFormalModules_affine. Restrict scalars to A and take its tilde H. AdicCompletion.ofLinearEquiv makes the completion finite over A; Module.Finite.trans makes the restricted module finite over A. The tilde top-section isomorphism and quasicoherent_finite_type_affine give finite type; isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType makes H coherent. Set A0=H. The unit of E followed by its inverse-system comparison gives e.

Reuse the proved canonical completionPullbackIso, its levelwise powerQuotientIso and projection equation powerQuotientIso_π, and coherent_pullback from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSystemsPullback via a proof-only import all. These helpers construct pullback of quotient systems by cokernels and preserve the actual quotient projections. Properness makes Z Noetherian, so coherent_pullback gives a coherent P=p* A0. Compose the canonical comparison with the pullback of e inverse and beta to obtain q. Register full and faithful for proper completion using its Hom bijection, lift q with preimageIso through the fully faithful coherent-formal inclusion and completion, and forget to ambient modules to obtain b.

The completion image of b.hom is the constructed formal isomorphism, by map_preimage for completion and the fully faithful inclusion of coherent formal systems. Evaluate at op n. The defining cokernel equation gives pi followed by completion(b)=b followed by pi. Expand the formal isomorphism and use the proved projection equation for the canonical quotient pullback comparison. Reassociate to obtain exactly the displayed quotient compatibility.

theorem formalComparison_algebraization_quotient_lift
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [IsProper p]
    (G : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (F : CoherentModules Z)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap p) F.obj) :
    ∃ (A₀ : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)))
      (e : G.obj ≅ formalCompletionSystem J A₀.obj)
      (b : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj A₀.obj ≅ F.obj),
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) A₀.obj) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).map (e.inv.app (op n)) ≫ β.hom.app (op n) =
        b.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap p) (n + 1) F.obj
